column5: GIOVANNI: Gone. / Neither of us could hold it here. / Perhaps absolute power was never / something a person could own. / There is nothing left for me / to take from this place.
LANCE: This is where / I lost sight of them. / GIOVANNI’s signal was / breaking. / MEWTWO was beginning to / choose for itself.
GIOVANNI: The signal / still holds. / MEWTWO, return to me.
MEWTWO: GYAAOOO! / LANCE: It’s rejecting / his control!
GIOVANNI: MEWTWO! / You will not escape me. / Not again!
LANCE: It fled north. / GIOVANNI followed it toward / CERULEAN CAVE.
